Copied unchanged from knip's `packages/knip/fixtures/imports/circular-dependencies`
at [webpro-nl/knip@13d7f21e8ec5](https://github.com/webpro-nl/knip/tree/13d7f21e8ec5b30d8fe6d8377c9012b9db96f871/packages/knip/fixtures/imports/circular-dependencies),
